ios.desc:
Break away from ordinary clock faces and numerical displays. TextTime revolutionizes time-telling by presenting time in words, not numbers.

Experience the fun and engaging benefits of a word-based clock widget. With TextTime, telling time becomes an enjoyable and interactive part of your day. Watch as your clock transforms into a unique expression of words, bringing a fresh and personalized touch to your device. Enjoy the elegance of a minimalist design that communicates time in a human-friendly format, making every glance at your clock a delightful experience.

Tell time your way. Customize the formatting of the time as you desire, and the app will remember your choices. Personalize your clock with settings for Zero Phrase, Morning Phrase, and Afternoon Phrase, allowing you to infuse each moment with your unique flair. Effortlessly add prefixes and suffixes to further tailor your time displays to perfection. With TextTime, time isn't just measured—it's expressed in your own words.

Download TextTime now and embrace a new era of timekeeping, where words take center stage and transform how you perceive time!

Free Features:
- Switch between 12/24-hour time
- Adjust text size
- Add as a widget to your Home or Lock Screen

Premium Features:
- Change background color
- Set custom prefix and suffix
- Customize morning, afternoon, and night phrases
- Change text color, font, boldness, justification, and casing

show_hn.title: Show HN: I brought the best Pebble watch feature to iOS and Apple Watch

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I wanted to share something exciting that I've been working on. Remember the classic word clock feature from Pebble watches? It was my default on my pebble steel (Still working like a charm to this day!). I've always loved how unique and visually appealing it was, so I decided to bring that experience to iOS and Apple Watch.

Introducing Custom Word Clock - TextTime: a fully customizable word clock widget for iOS. You can personalize it to fit your style and preferences. It started as a widget for the home screen, and I'm thrilled to announce that it's now available as a lock screen widget and a complication on the Apple Watch.

Here's what you can expect:

Customization: Choose unique greetings, fonts, colors, and backgrounds to create a word clock that suits your taste.

Widgets: Add the word clock to your iPhone's home screen and lock screen for quick access. Customization in the app applies directly to the widget.

Apple Watch Complication: Get the word clock experience right on your wrist with our new complication.

Numbers are so last year—why not add words to your watch? I'm really proud of how it turned out and would love to hear your thoughts and feedback!

App Link: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/custom-word-clock-texttime/id6449908609
